// Throwaway writer for the runtime state upgrade fixture: dropped into an
// earlier release's pkg/alarmd/state, it writes Runtime State through that
// release's own store into a real redis-server, loads it back with the same
// release, and saves every key's raw bytes and the loaded views to XV_OUT.

package state

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"sort"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/go-redis/redis/v8"

	"github.com/TencentBlueKing/bkmonitor-datalink/pkg/alarmd/contract"
	"github.com/TencentBlueKing/bkmonitor-datalink/pkg/alarmd/execution"
)

func TestWriteRuntimeStateUpgradeFixture(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("XV_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("XV_OUT is not set")
	}
	executable, err := exec.LookPath("redis-server")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	address := reserveTCPAddress(t)
	startRedisServer(t, executable, address)
	backend, err := NewRedisBackend(RedisBackendOptions{Address: address, DialTimeout: time.Second, ReadTimeout: time.Second, WriteTimeout: time.Second, PoolSize: 2})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = backend.Close() })
	waitRedisReady(t, backend)
	router, err := NewFixedRouter("redis", backend)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	store, err := NewExecutionStore(ExecutionStoreOptions{Prefix: "alarmd-upgrade", Router: router, MaxValueBytes: 1 << 20,
		MaxItemsPerCall: 64, MinTTL: time.Minute, MaxTTL: time.Hour, RestartMargin: time.Minute})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// Late enough that every point of a thirty-minute history has a positive
	// source time.
	version := applyVersion()
	version.EvaluationTime = 7200
	at := int64(version.EvaluationTime)
	// Series digests and record ids as production forms them: a SHA-256
	// digest, and each record id derived from it and the source time.
	build := func(series string, mutation execution.StateMutation) execution.StateMutation {
		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(series))
		mutation.Identity = seriesIdentity(0)
		mutation.Identity.SeriesIdentityDigest = execution.SeriesIdentityDigest(hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]))
		mutation.ApplyVersion = version
		derive := func(at int64) string {
			id, err := contract.DeriveRecordIDV2(string(mutation.Identity.SeriesIdentityDigest), at)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			return id
		}
		for index := range mutation.AffectedRecords {
			mutation.AffectedRecords[index].RecordID = derive(mutation.AffectedRecords[index].SourceTime)
		}
		for index := range mutation.Points {
			mutation.Points[index].RecordID = derive(mutation.Points[index].SourceTime)
		}
		built, err := execution.BuildStateMutation(mutation)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", series, err)
		}
		return built
	}
	var history []execution.StateHistoryPoint
	for index := int64(0); index < 30; index++ {
		result := execution.LevelFactNormal
		if index%3 == 0 {
			result = execution.LevelFactAnomalous
		}
		history = append(history, execution.StateHistoryPoint{RecordID: "long", SourceTime: at - 60*(29-index),
			Levels: []execution.StateLevelFact{{LevelID: 1, DetectFingerprint: "detect-1", Result: result}, {LevelID: 2, DetectFingerprint: "detect-2", Result: execution.LevelFactNormal}}})
	}
	mutations := []execution.StateMutation{
		build("one-level-normal", execution.StateMutation{
			AffectedRecords: []execution.RecordAnchor{{RecordID: "r1", SourceTime: at}},
			Levels: []execution.RuntimeLevelStateMutation{{LevelID: 1, LevelStateCompatibility: "compat", HistoryCompleteness: execution.HistoryFull,
				WarmupRequirementRef: "warm", LastProcessedEventTime: at}},
			Points: []execution.StateHistoryPoint{{RecordID: "r1", SourceTime: at,
				Levels: []execution.StateLevelFact{{LevelID: 1, DetectFingerprint: "detect", Result: execution.LevelFactNormal}}}}}),
		build("two-levels-guarded", execution.StateMutation{
			AffectedRecords: []execution.RecordAnchor{{RecordID: "r2", SourceTime: at - 60}, {RecordID: "r2", SourceTime: at}},
			SeriesGuard:     &execution.StateGuardFact{Status: execution.HistoryWarming, ReasonCode: "HISTORY_WARMING", WarmupRequirementRef: "warm-guard"},
			Levels: []execution.RuntimeLevelStateMutation{
				{LevelID: 1, LevelStateCompatibility: "compat-1", HistoryCompleteness: execution.HistoryFull, WarmupRequirementRef: "warm-1", LastProcessedEventTime: at},
				{LevelID: 2, LevelStateCompatibility: "compat-2", HistoryCompleteness: execution.HistoryGapped, GapReasonCode: "HISTORY_GAPPED", WarmupRequirementRef: "warm-2", LastProcessedEventTime: at - 60}},
			Points: []execution.StateHistoryPoint{
				{RecordID: "r2", SourceTime: at - 60, Levels: []execution.StateLevelFact{{LevelID: 1, DetectFingerprint: "d1", Result: execution.LevelFactAnomalous}, {LevelID: 2, DetectFingerprint: "d2", Result: execution.LevelFactUnavailable}}},
				{RecordID: "r2", SourceTime: at, Levels: []execution.StateLevelFact{{LevelID: 1, DetectFingerprint: "d1", Result: execution.LevelFactNormal}, {LevelID: 2, DetectFingerprint: "d2", Result: execution.LevelFactError}}}}}),
		build("long-history", execution.StateMutation{
			AffectedRecords: []execution.RecordAnchor{{RecordID: "long", SourceTime: at}},
			Levels: []execution.RuntimeLevelStateMutation{
				{LevelID: 1, LevelStateCompatibility: "compat-1", HistoryCompleteness: execution.HistoryFull, WarmupRequirementRef: "warm-1", LastProcessedEventTime: at},
				{LevelID: 2, LevelStateCompatibility: "compat-2", HistoryCompleteness: execution.HistoryFull, WarmupRequirementRef: "warm-2", LastProcessedEventTime: at}},
			Points: history}),
		build("warming-level", execution.StateMutation{
			AffectedRecords: []execution.RecordAnchor{{RecordID: "r4", SourceTime: at}},
			Levels: []execution.RuntimeLevelStateMutation{{LevelID: 3, LevelStateCompatibility: "compat-3", HistoryCompleteness: execution.HistoryWarming,
				GapReasonCode: "HISTORY_WARMING", WarmupRequirementRef: "warm-3", LastProcessedEventTime: at}},
			Points: []execution.StateHistoryPoint{{RecordID: "r4", SourceTime: at,
				Levels: []execution.StateLevelFact{{LevelID: 3, DetectFingerprint: "detect-3", Result: execution.LevelFactAnomalous}}}}}),
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	applied, err := store.ApplyRuntime(ctx, execution.StateApplyRequest{Contract: frozenRef(), Retention: testRetention(), Items: mutations})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for index, item := range applied.Items {
		if item.Status != execution.StateApplied {
			t.Fatalf("mutation %d: %+v", index, item)
		}
	}
	items := preflightItems(mutations)
	loaded, err := store.LoadRuntime(ctx, execution.StatePreflightRequest{Contract: frozenRef(), Items: items})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	client := redis.NewClient(&redis.Options{Addr: address})
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = client.Close() })
	keys, err := client.Keys(ctx, "*").Result()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	type storedKey struct {
		Key    string `json:"key"`
		Type   string `json:"type"`
		Value  string `json:"value_base64"`
		TTLMin int64  `json:"ttl_ms"`
	}
	var stored []storedKey
	for _, key := range keys {
		kind := client.Type(ctx, key).Val()
		if kind != "string" {
			t.Fatalf("key %s is a %s; the fixture keeps strings only", key, kind)
		}
		value, err := client.Get(ctx, key).Bytes()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		stored = append(stored, storedKey{Key: key, Type: kind, Value: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(value), TTLMin: client.PTTL(ctx, key).Val().Milliseconds()})
	}
	fixture := map[string]any{"source_commit": os.Getenv("XV_SOURCE"), "prefix": "alarmd-upgrade", "contract": frozenRef(),
		"items": items, "views": loaded.Items, "keys": stored}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(fixture, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, append(data, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("wrote %d keys and %d views to %s", len(stored), len(loaded.Items), out)
}
